answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a copper counter-signature, and the cedar graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 32% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, recorded as a pigment edge. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
